component.name: Midgar
component.summary: Write and read your own books, privately and offline

description.p: Midgar is a quiet, distraction-free personal library. Organise long-form writing into books and chapters, write in Markdown with inline pictures, and read it back in a clean, book-like view.
Everything stays on your device in a single private database. Midgar has no accounts, no sync and makes no network connections.
Rebuilt as a native GTK 4 / libadwaita application.
